addons.name: Official template catalog (moorage-templates)
addons.description: Connects Literally-davca/moorage-templates as a remote template index with daily refresh.

resources.ram: +1–2 MB (in-memory during daily refresh; ~0 MB idle)

addons.name: Prometheus & Grafana metrics
addons.description: Exposes /metrics for Prometheus/VictoriaMetrics and generates tailored Grafana dashboards, scrape/alert rules, and Homelab snippets.

addons.name: Proxy & dashboard label detection
addons.description: Automatically detect service web URLs from Traefik, Caddy and Homepage container labels.

addons.name: Coolify integration
addons.description: Human display names over stable Coolify UUIDs, collapsible project groups, Start/Stop/Restart/Redeploy actions, deployment logs and .env sync.

resources.ram: +2–5 MB (60s API cache per Coolify host)

addons.name: Stack scheduler (cron tasks)
addons.description: 5-field cron scheduler for stack actions (restart, start, stop, pull + up) and gated container exec jobs.

addons.name: Docker socket security guard
addons.description: Audits stacks and containers for raw /var/run/docker.sock mounts and unencrypted :2375 sockets with a socket-proxy generator.

addons.name: Instant registry push webhooks
addons.description: GHCR, Docker Hub and Gitea/Harbor push webhooks that trigger immediate image checks and optional auto-updates.

addons.name: Scoped MCP server for AI assistants
addons.description: Streamable HTTP /mcp server with per-host/stack ACL tokens, write-only .env secret handling, and human-approval drafts.

addons.name: Beszel Hub
addons.description: Lightweight server and container resource monitoring hub (henrygd/beszel) with historical charts and alerts.

addons.name: Beszel Agent
addons.description: Lightweight host and Docker metrics collector (henrygd/beszel-agent) for any Moorage host.

addons.name: Restic volume backups
addons.description: Optional scheduled Restic container for encrypted, deduplicated backups of stack volumes.

resources.ram: +0 MB between runs / +30–120 MB during backup job
resources.cpu: ~0% idle / moderate burst during compression & encryption

addons.name: Trivy CVE vulnerability scanner
addons.description: Optional sidecar container for scanning stack container images for known CVEs without bloating the Moorage binary.

resources.ram: +40 MB idle (server) / +150–400 MB during image scan
resources.cpu: ~0% idle / 1–2 cores burst for 5–20s per image scan
